asset_use_policy: External comparative references only. Do not download, distribute or bundle screenshot bitmaps into the game.
authority: Call of Duty: World at War (2008), original PC/Xbox 360/PS3/Wii screenshots, NOT Final Fronts, Nintendo DS, BO3 Chronicles, Vanguard or COD Mobile
source_description: IMFDB labeled original World at War screenshot gallery. Image numbers refer to image ordering in the page captions, not pixel coordinates or downloadable game assets.
compare_requirements: HIP hands support surfaces and trigger grip vs original WaW
ADS both rear AND front align with camera optical axis when both exist
shotguns with only front bead are NOT tested against imaginary rear sight
scoped rifles display original magnified reticle layout, not opaque glass or unscoped rifle
original per-gun stance/cant differences explicitly reviewed, not flattened into one generic pose
Do not override original source DT_Weapons ADS input or fabricated FOV/speed per weapon
Do not mark original 2008 screenshot verified unless visually compared with Godot frame at matched viewport/FOV

357.visual_truth: WaW first-person revolver aiming upward; verify hands wrap grip, not weapon floating from trigger hand.

colt.visual_truth: Original WaW one-hand 1911 sight picture; do not introduce a gangster cant or detached supporting hand.

walther.visual_truth: Original centered vertical pistol rear notch and front post visible; WaW multiplayer screenshot.

nambu.visual_truth: IMPORTANT: Original WaW intentionally has slightly offset front post / point of impact. Compare the in-game sight picture rather than forcing symmetric iron-sight geometry.

tt33.visual_truth: Frame 22 shows player aiming in actual 2008 campaign; not a clean isolated neutral-sky ironsight reference.

mp40.visual_truth: 2008 native source hip reference documents correct support-hand grasp on MAGWELL, not magazine. This IMFDB gallery lacks clean straight-ahead ADS screenshot; supplement from authentic gameplay footage.

thompson.visual_truth: Use original 2008 first-person sight picture and gripping geometry, not generic centered procedural mesh.

ppsh.visual_truth: Original screenshot uses stick magazine; Nacht/Zombies can have drum. Front post centered inside distinctive U-notch/aperture; verify magazine variant separately.

type100.visual_truth: WaW 2008 intentionally cants weapon COUNTERCLOCKWISE in ADS because support hand grips the magazine. Exact game look != anatomically ideal straight rifle.

stg.visual_truth: 2008 original StG-44 is grasped by magazine, not an ideal realistic handguard; source visual reference is thin rifle centerline.

m1.visual_truth: Distinctive Garand large circular rear aperture around central front sight; source screenshot matched at native FOV.

m1a1.visual_truth: Original 2008 game labels it M1A1 despite using nonfolding M1 stock; preserve actual in-game aperture and silhouette.

gewehr.visual_truth: Use original 2008 first-person sight picture and gripping geometry, not generic centered procedural mesh.

svt40.visual_truth: Use original 2008 first-person sight picture and gripping geometry, not generic centered procedural mesh.

arisaka.visual_truth: 2008 unscoped iron ADS and separately scoped version frame 88 (offset real sight axis). Do not mistake scope bone for iron sight.

kar98k.visual_truth: Unscoped sight frame 110, optional scoped reticle frame 116.

springfield.visual_truth: Unscoped frame 157 and singleplayer sniper scope view frame 163; a raw transparent glass disc is NOT the original scoped ADS screen.

mosin.visual_truth: Unscoped iron frame 138, scoped Mosin frame 147. Original scoped ADS is a dedicated through-optic reticle, not a 2m opaque tube.

ptrs.visual_truth: Original WaW PTRS shown ALWAYS SCOPED with a full optical scope view; do not treat as generic rear + front iron sights.

trench.visual_truth: Original WaW has ONLY FRONT BEAD and historically points slightly too high. Never demand nonexistent rear notch alignment.

doublebarrel.visual_truth: Original twin barrels and simple shotgun sight line; no rear iron aperture.

sawnoff.visual_truth: Separate original sawed-off visual reference; shared DoubleBarrel animation provenance is valid, but model grip still needs screenshot validation.

fg42.visual_truth: Original campaign iron sights have unusually high ADS zoom (source FOV profile must be distinguished from physical geometry).
